up: Find all compounds that have activity data against the human protein target 'Muscleblind-like protein 1' (ChEMBL ID: CHEMBL1293317). For each compound, return the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the preferred name (pref_name), and the canonical SMILES string. Do not apply any additional filters on activity type, units, or relation. Return one row per unique compound.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM target_dictionary td
JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid
JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293317'
